name: human-readable-chinese-writing
description: Draft, rewrite, and review readable Chinese while preserving meaning, facts, and uncertainty.

displayDescription.en: Turn Chinese drafts, work notes, and articles into clear, natural prose. Preserve meaning and uncertainty, flag missing facts, and avoid invented claims.
displayDescription.zh: 帮你把中文初稿、工作记录和文章改得自然好读，保留原意、事实与不确定性，指出缺失信息，不编造内容。

quickPrompts.en: Rewrite the following Chinese text to make it natural and easy to read without changing its meaning.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把下面这段中文改得自然、好读，不要改原意。

quickPrompts.en: Turn my work notes into a weekly report. Avoid exaggeration and mark missing details.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的工作记录写一段周报，不夸大，缺的信息标待确认。

quickPrompts.en: Review this draft without rewriting it yet. Point out what is hard to read and explain why.
quickPrompts.zh: 先别改稿，指出这段话哪里难读、为什么。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Rewrite the following Chinese text to make it natural and easy to read without changing its meaning.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把下面这段中文改得自然、好读，不要改原意。
